rows.note: Official records identify a ten-year enterprise framework and a J&A route grounded in continuity and integration claims.
rows.next: Acquire the official J&A bytes, order-level decisions, operational metrics, and independent transition assessments.
rows.fals: The framework remains lightly used, nonexclusive, and unrelated to the asserted continuity risks.

rows.note: The J&A locator and public descriptions identify the categories of sufficiency; exact estimates, assumptions, and acceptance thresholds remain incomplete.
rows.ceil: continuity thresholds named but not fully receipted
rows.next: Acquire transition cost models, schedules, risk matrices, approval memoranda, independent estimates, and version history.
rows.fals: The official J&A and supporting record contain no material transition threshold or the estimates are disproved by testing.

rows.note: The government must justify the exception; the current record does not show how independently vendor assertions, user experience, and alternative estimates were tested.
rows.ceil: formal burden with unresolved evidentiary independence
rows.next: Acquire author, source, review, concurrence, market-research, and independent-validation records for each J&A assertion.
rows.fals: Independent records fully validate the asserted burdens and show symmetric consideration of alternatives.

rows.note: The current evidence describes expected disruption and cost, not a completed full-scale replacement exercise.
rows.ceil: documentary continuity decision before observed exit
rows.next: Acquire staged migration tests, fallback exercises, data and workflow export, reaccreditation, continuity, and acceptance outcomes.
rows.fals: Observed replacement was completed rapidly and proportionately before the enterprise decision.

rows.note: Public records expose the framework and parts of the rights allocation, but not the full interface, log, configuration, and transition archive.
rows.next: Acquire the complete record-custody matrix, retention rules, interface and ontology versions, logs, transition deliverables, and audit rights.
rows.fals: The Army independently holds a complete, current, exportable, and auditable operating archive.

rows.note: The current record names alternatives and expected costs but lacks an observed enterprise substitution with comparable mission load.
rows.next: Acquire alternative prototypes, component substitutions, migration pilots, failed paths, costs, schedules, and performance.
rows.fals: A viable alternative operated at comparable scale and was rejected despite equal or better outcomes.

rows.note: The public record identifies an exception route and enterprise framework without proving that every order is exempt or that the exception was improper.
rows.next: Acquire each exception, order, competition decision, waiver, concurrence, modification, and non-Palantir component path.
rows.fals: Orders were routinely competed or the exception was never materially used.

rows.note: The records establish mixed public data and private software rights and a large purchasing vehicle, not disproportionate benefit or extraction.
rows.ceil: partial enterprise error and benefit metabolism
rows.next: Acquire obligations, outlays, recognized revenue, costs, margins, performance, refunds, recovery rights, transition expenditures, and public capacity.
rows.fals: Complete records show proportionate value, strong public rights, low transition burden, and no asymmetric residual benefit.
